//: The 'Did you know?' tips live sends at login, one chosen at random, worded as in revisions 238-239 (one is cut short on live too). See docs/settings.md.
tips: Did you know? As well as selling you new boats and helping you customise them, shipwrights can also help you recover a lost boat or destroy a boat you no longer need.</col>
Did you know? Boat repair kits can be used to fix up a damaged boat. You can make boat repair kits at a shipwrights' workbench, which are found near all shipwrights.</col>
Did you know? Boats can be stored in boat bottles, letting you carry them from one port to another.</col>
Did you know? Boats have an escape option on their helm, allowing you return to dry land if you're ever in trouble.</col>
Did you know? Eating a strange fruit cures poison and venom as well as restoring run energy.</col>
Did you know? If you hold any anti-poison or anti-venom potions, clicking on the health orb while poisoned will cure you without cancelling your actions.</col>
Did you know? If you stand on the same tile as your box trap, it will fail to catch 100% of the time.</col>
Did you know? Kebabs are one of the items you can use on a compost bin to make regular compost.</col>
Did you know? Most bosses which are not instanced have a right-click 'peek' option on or near their entrance that lets you see how many people are currently fighting it.</col>
Did you know? Not all snelms give the same damage protection against snail acid attacks. Red snelms and pointed blue snelms are the most effective.</col>
Did you know? Thanks to the House Viewer in the House options, you can move and rotate rooms in your house without changing their content.</col>
Did you know? The Twinflame staff from Royal Titans will automatically cast the correct elemental spell for a foe's weakness.</col>
Did you know? The fire in the Ruins of Unkah is actually considered a range.</col>
Did you know? There is a setting in the Bank settings and on the Bank Deposit interface that lets you lock slots in your inventory so their content doesn't get deposited.</col>
Did you know? There is a setting in the Settings menu to automatically re-enable running once you have regained enough energy. This will however interrupt any action in progress.</col>
Did you know? There is a setting to allow you to get Strength XP when pushing through the wheat in Puro-Puro.</col>
Did you know? There is an option in the Settings menu to automatically smash empty pots once you have finished planting them.</col>
Did you know? There is an option in the Settings menu to automatically smash empty vials once you have finished emptying them.</col>
Did you know? There's a man called Phials in Rimmington that will unnote items for a small fee, right next to a house portal. Perfect for any Construction needs.</col>
Did you know? There's a man called Phials in Rimmington that will unnote items for a small fee. Perfect for Ultimate Ironmen.</col>
Did you know? Wearing a charged Amulet of Glory while mining will increase the rate at which you find gems.</col>
Did you know? You can attempt to catch most Hunter creatures you don't have the Hunter level to catch. You will just fail 100% of the time.</col>
Did you know? You can buy a bolt pouch from Hirko in Keldagrim that lets you carry up to 5 different bolt types at once, including a mithril grapple.</col>
Did you know? You can buy basic farming gear, including plant cure, by talking to farmers near farming patches.</col>
Did you know? You can change any aspect of your appearance at any makeover provider by using the button in the top left corner of any makeover interface.</col>
Did you know? You can combine enchanted jewellery items, as you would decant potions, by taking them to Murky Matt at the Grand Exchange.</col>
Did you know? You can decant potions into any number of doses by taking them to Bob Barter at the Grand Exchange or Zahur in Nardah.</col>
Did you know? You can eat a food item, drink a potion and eat a Cooked karambwan in the same tick, as long as you do it in that order.</col>
Did you know? You can enter the Kalphite lair from the caves south of Dorgesh-Kaan. Bring a light source!</col>
Did you know? You can hide the Help button in the Bank interface via the Bank settings.</col>

Did you know? You can invite friends onto your boat and even allow them to navigate it for you. Set a friend as a navigator by using the Sailing sidepanel, or by using your Captain's log on them.</col
Did you know? You can note produce by using it on the Tool Leprechaun.</col>
Did you know? You can pick Zamorak grapes from the Vinery with Bologa's blessing, a Tithe Farm reward that can be unlocked for a fee by talking to Bologa while wearing a Zamorak item.</col>
Did you know? You can put two halves of a pizza together to make a whole pizza!</col>
Did you know? You can right-click any fairy ring to travel to any other fairy ring without passing through Zanaris.</col>
Did you know? You can right-click any of the Spirit Anglers to leave a Tempoross fight faster once it has ended.</col>
Did you know? You can smash barrels in the Viyeldi caves for a chance at random treasure, including noted cooked sharks.</col>
Did you know? You can upgrade regular compost to supercompost by using a compost potion on the bin or the bucket.</col>
Did you know? You can use basalt on Snowflake in Weiss to note it.</col>
Did you know? You can use the Humidify Lunar spell to water all of your saplings at once.</col>
